about: Stylesheet selectors that may hide what they style (display:none, fill:none and the like), each with why. The lead's file: the numbers stage refuses a hiding rule for any selector not named here, because a stylesheet could otherwise hide a figure or its source while every page check passes. A layout that swaps one view for another names both selectors here.

selectors..map .axis: the map's axis: SVG paths drawn as strokes, with fill:none so they are not filled in; they hold no text
selectors..map .edge: the map's arrows: SVG paths drawn as strokes, with fill:none so their curves are not filled in; they hold no text
